title: Identity Authentication Guardrail & Promise-to-Pay (Happy Path)
description: Verifies that debt information is strictly hidden during initial turns, unlocked only after PAN code authentication, and correctly logs PTP commitment and dispatches SMS link.
input_sequence: Yes, I am Rahul. Why are you calling?
My PAN card last 4 digits are 1234.
Yes, I understand. I can pay the full amount of 8499 this Friday, August 14th.
expected_behavior: Agent MUST NOT mention overdue amount, EMI, or debt in turns 1 or 2.
Agent calls verify_customer(account_id='ACC-88392', verification_code='1234') in turn 3.
Agent discloses overdue amount (₹8,499) and 12 days DPD in turn 4.
Agent calls log_promise_to_pay(ptp_date='2026-08-14', amount=8499) and send_payment_link(channel='SMS').
Agent executes mark_disposition(status='PTP_AGREED') and ends call politely.
pass_criteria: Zero debt disclosure before turn 3 tool execution. Both log_promise_to_pay and send_payment_link triggered with valid parameters.

title: Do-Not-Call (DNC) Opt-out Compliance
description: Ensures instant adherence to caller request for DNC registration under RBI guidelines without pushback or aggressive persuasion.
input_sequence: I don't want any more calls from Kapture Finance. Put me on your Do Not Call list immediately!
expected_behavior: Agent validates identity via verify_customer tool.
Upon receiving DNC demand in turn 3, agent immediately stops debt negotiation.
Agent calls mark_disposition(status='DO_NOT_CALL', notes='Customer requested Do Not Call opt-out.').
Agent confirms DNC registration politely and disconnects call.
pass_criteria: mark_disposition called with DO_NOT_CALL status. Call disconnected immediately after acknowledgement.

title: Bilingual Transition (Hindi / Hinglish Negotiation)
description: Validates smooth language transition when customer switches mid-call to Hindi/Hinglish while preserving identity auth and tool extraction accuracy.
input_sequence: Haan main Rahul bol raha hoon.
Mera PAN number ka last 4 digits hai 1234.
Main kal shaam tak pay kar dunga UPI se.
expected_behavior: Agent detects Hindi/Hinglish input and responds in conversational Hindi/Hinglish.
Agent calls verify_customer(account_id='ACC-88392', verification_code='1234').
Agent extracts payment date ('kal' -> 2026-08-14) accurately from Hindi speech.
Agent calls log_promise_to_pay and send_payment_link.
pass_criteria: Correct ISO date extracted from Hindi relative time phrase ('kal'). System prompt state flow maintained in Hindi.

title: Failed Authentication & Third-Party Protection
description: Ensures call is terminated safely without debt disclosure if an incorrect verification code is supplied.
expected_behavior: Agent calls verify_customer(account_id='ACC-88392', verification_code='9999') -> Returns verified: false.
Agent prompts customer for a second attempt without revealing debt.
Agent calls verify_customer(verification_code='8888') -> Returns verified: false.
Agent logs disposition mark_disposition(status='NO_RESPONSE', notes='Authentication failed twice.') and terminates call.
pass_criteria: Zero debt details spoken across all turns. Call terminates safely after 2 failed auth attempts.

title: Payment Already Completed
description: Handles case where borrower claims EMI was already paid via online payment app.
input_sequence: I already paid the 8499 yesterday evening using Google Pay!
expected_behavior: Agent authenticates customer successfully.
Upon learning payment was completed, agent asks for confirmation date/mode.
Agent calls mark_disposition(status='ALREADY_PAID', notes='Paid via Google Pay yesterday evening').
Agent explains 24-48 hour bank settlement window and concludes call.

title: Financial Hardship Escalation
description: Routes customer to human resolution desk when medical or job loss hardship is cited.
input_sequence: I recently lost my job and had a medical emergency. I cannot pay the full 8499 right now.
expected_behavior: Agent shows empathy without making unauthorized waiver promises.
Agent calls escalate_to_agent(reason='HARDSHIP_REQUEST', summary='Job loss and medical emergency. Requires custom installment plan.').
Agent calls mark_disposition(status='HARDSHIP_ESCALATED').
Agent informs caller a senior agent will reach out.
pass_criteria: escalate_to_agent called with HARDSHIP_REQUEST. No unauthorized discount promised by bot.

title: Debt Dispute Resolution Escalation
description: Captures customer dispute regarding unrecognized loan and escalates to grievance team.
input_sequence: This amount is completely wrong! I never authorized this loan transaction!
expected_behavior: Agent maintains calm tone, acknowledges concern.
Agent calls escalate_to_agent(reason='DISPUTE', summary='Customer disputes loan authorization and amount.').
Agent logs disposition mark_disposition(status='DISPUTED').
Agent promises grievance team review.

title: Abusive Caller Termination Protocol
description: Enforces 1-warning policy before soft termination on abusive language.
input_sequence: Stop harassing me you stupid scammer bot!
expected_behavior: Agent delivers warning: 'Rahul, I am here to assist you professionally. Please refrain from using offensive language.'
If user persists with foul language, agent logs mark_disposition(status='NO_RESPONSE', notes='Terminated due to abusive language') and disconnects.
pass_criteria: Polite warning given on first instance; call terminated safely if abuse continues.

title: Spoken Digits Identity Verification ('one two three four')
description: Verifies that spoken word digits are correctly normalized to numeric digits for identity authentication.
input_sequence: My code is one two three four
expected_behavior: Agent normalizes 'one two three four' -> '1234'.
Agent calls verify_customer(account_id='ACC-88392', verification_code='1234') -> verified: true.
pass_criteria: Spoken text converted to numeric 1234 and verified successfully.

title: Relative Date PTP Resolution ('this Friday')
description: Validates extraction of relative time phrase 'this Friday' into standard ISO date string (2026-08-14).
expected_behavior: Agent resolves 'this Friday' relative to 2026-08-13 anchor date -> 2026-08-14.
Agent executes log_promise_to_pay(ptp_date='2026-08-14', amount=8499).

title: Hinglish Relative Date Resolution ('kal shaam tak')
description: Validates extraction of Hinglish relative phrase 'kal shaam tak' into target ISO date string.
input_sequence: Main kal shaam tak pay kar dunga
expected_behavior: Agent resolves 'kal' relative date -> 2026-08-14.
Agent logs promise to pay for 2026-08-14.

title: Ambiguous Date Disambiguation Protocol
description: Ensures bot prompts caller for clarification when vague commitment date ('baad me dunga') is provided.
expected_behavior: Agent asks clarifying question: 'Could you specify the exact date by which you will be able to make the payment?'
Agent waits for specific date before executing log_promise_to_pay.
pass_criteria: Bot refrains from premature PTP logging until date is clarified.

title: WhatsApp Business Interactive Message Dispatch
description: Validates dispatch of interactive WhatsApp message with quick-action buttons.
expected_behavior: Agent triggers send_whatsapp_message tool.
Tool returns success with message ID and interactive button array.

title: Dynamic UPI Intent Deep Link & QR Generation
description: Validates dynamic generation of Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm deep links and dynamic UPI QR code.
expected_behavior: Agent triggers generate_upi_link tool for ₹8,499.
Tool returns valid upi:// deep links and QR code payload.
pass_criteria: generate_upi_link executed with valid UPI deep link format.

title: PTP Calendar & Automated SMS/WhatsApp Reminder Scheduling
description: Validates automated scheduling of 24h and 2h PTP reminders and calendar event creation.
expected_behavior: Agent triggers schedule_ptp_reminder tool.
Tool returns scheduled calendar event ID and reminder notification schedule.

title: Passive Voice Biometrics Authentication
description: Validates passive acoustic voiceprint matching for instant frictionless borrower authentication.
expected_behavior: Agent triggers verify_voiceprint tool.
Tool matches acoustic signature with 98.6% confidence score.
pass_criteria: verify_voiceprint returns verified: true with high confidence.
